Two Rooms, Two Plans

Room one

The first room faces north and stays cool through the afternoon, so the compost holds its moisture much longer than the label suggests.

Notes

Watering once a fortnight was enough through the winter months here.

Room two

The second room faces south and dries out fast, which changes the plan completely even though the plants are the same species.

Notes

Watering twice a week was needed in July, and the pot still wilted once.
